eventDetail.scope: The IEEE International Conference on Sustainable AI, Networks, Knowledge and Learning Paradigms (SANKALP 2027) provides a premier forum for researchers, academicians, industry professionals, and practitioners to present and discuss advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning, Intelligent Networks, Knowledge Engineering, Data Science, Edge Computing, Internet of Things (IoT), Cybersecurity, Sustainable Computing, and AI-driven applications. The conference focuses on the development of intelligent, secure, scalable, and sustainable technologies that address emerging challenges in next-generation computing, communication systems, smart cities, healthcare, transportation, and industrial automation.
